## Why This Matters
Smallest PDLI project by outlay (₹4.28 crore). Registered in Delhi (2010); the DLI list places the project in Uttar Pradesh, where the company has a Greater Noida office.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Linear LED driver ICs.
